name: Aarav Marfatia
bio:
I am a 9th grader who loves to do robotics and coding, and I enjoy math and science alike. Outside of the classroom I play both the piano and the cello, so I know what it feels like to practice something over and over until it finally clicks. Working through a tricky problem and seeing it come together is one of my favorite feelings, and I like helping other people get to that same moment. Whether it is an equation that will not cooperate or a science concept that feels confusing, I am happy to slow down and walk through it step by step.

When I am tutoring, my goal is to make the material feel a lot less intimidating. I try to explain things in more than one way until it makes sense, and I never want anyone to feel embarrassed for asking a question. Come as you are, bring whatever you are stuck on, and we will figure it out together.

name: Adhidev Nithyanadan
bio:
I am a 9th grader with a true passion for all things cricket, math, and science, and I love the outdoors and enjoy learning something new every day. That curiosity is a big part of why I like tutoring: there is always another way to look at a problem, and I enjoy finding the explanation that finally makes it make sense for someone.

When we work together, I will meet you wherever you are and build up from there, no matter how stuck things feel at the start. I believe anyone can get better at math and science with a little patience and the right support, and I am here to be that support. Bring your questions and your assignment, and we will take it one step at a time.

name: Mateus Aguiar
bio:
I am a freshman at Wheeler Magnet who is passionate about math and STEM. Outside of class I like to play the piano, watch physics documentaries, walk my dog, and build and create new things. That curiosity about how things work is exactly what I bring to tutoring, because I love breaking a problem down until it finally makes sense.

When we work together, I will be patient and meet you at your level, no matter how stuck you feel at the start. My goal is for you to walk away not just with the answer, but with a real understanding of how to get there on your own next time. Bring whatever you are working on and we will take it one step at a time.
